Signed-off-by: wjhuang2016 <huangwenjun1997@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29560

Problem Summary:
When we call CharsetAndCollation, c.charset and c.collation can't be nil. So the rest of code can't be reached. We better remove these codes.

### What is changed and how it works?
1. Refine CharsetAndCollation
2. Add default charset and collation into the inner session.
